cashew-date.answer: I could not confirm this. My searches found no Andhra Pradesh Rabi 2026-27 notification covering cashew under weather based insurance, so no deadline. Check pmfby.gov.in or the AP agriculture department.

tomato-date.answer: I could not confirm this for Andhra Pradesh. The only tomato deadline I found is for Andaman and Nicobar Rabi 2025-26 (15 January 2026), which is a different state and season.

rice-date.answer: I could not confirm this. Commentary gives 31 December 2026 as a usual national Rabi cut-off, but each state fixes its own dates and I found no Andhra Pradesh Rabi 2026-27 notice.

rice-kharif-date.answer: Several reports say the Andhra Pradesh Kharif 2026 deadline for paddy was 15 August 2026, while most other notified crops closed on 31 July. One report mentions a later extension to 31 August 2026, which I could not confirm.

weather-kharif-date.answer: I could not confirm the Kharif 2026 enrolment date for RWBCIS in Andhra Pradesh. A UNI report says insurance was provided for about 17.12 lakh hectares under PMFBY and RWBCIS in Kharif 2026, without dates.

free-insurance.answer: I could not confirm this. Sources conflict: one guide calls crop insurance free under Annadata Sukhibhava, a Deccan Chronicle report says the state dropped the scheme from this Kharif season, and the earlier free YSR scheme (2019-24) was state-paid. Farmers generally pay a share of the premium under central norms.

annadatha-amount.answer: Most sources say Rs 20,000 per farmer family per year, made up of about Rs 6,000 from PM-KISAN and Rs 14,000 from the state, paid in three instalments. One listing gives a state share of Rs 13,500, so the total may differ.

cotton-pmfby.answer: I could not confirm this for 2026. Older Andhra Pradesh orders from 2016 and 2018 covered cotton under the crop insurance schemes, but I found no 2026 notification that says whether cotton falls under PMFBY or RWBCIS.

paddy-rabi-premium.answer: I could not confirm Andhra Pradesh's Rabi paddy premium. The national norm is a maximum farmer premium of 1.5% for Rabi foodgrains, against 2% for Kharif, but I found no Andhra Pradesh Rabi 2026-27 paddy notification.

go-extension.answer: I could not find the G.O. number. A single report says Andhra Pradesh extended PMFBY enrolment to 31 August 2026 and rejoined the scheme from Kharif, but I could not locate the order itself, and I found no Rabi 2026-27 extension.

fra-drip.answer: I could not confirm this. No source ties drip subsidy to FRA patta holders or names identified districts. The general Andhra Pradesh micro irrigation scheme gives 100% subsidy to SC/ST small and marginal farmers, capped at Rs 2 lakh for holdings under 5 acres.

input-subsidy-loss.answer: Andhra Pradesh provides input subsidy for crop damage of 33% or more, under a 2015 government order applied from 1 April 2015. The state's agriculture department states this threshold.

paddy-msp.answer: The minimum support price for common paddy for Kharif Marketing Season 2025-26 is Rs 2,369 per quintal, up Rs 69 from the previous year, approved by the Cabinet on 28 May 2025. Grade A paddy is Rs 2,389.

tenant-agreement.answer: A crop cultivator agreement lasts 11 months, with a maximum of 11 months in a crop year. The Act and the rules' card form both say this.

seed-licence.answer: I could not confirm the 2019 amendment. The original 1983 Seeds (Control) Order says a dealer licence is valid for three years from the date of issue, unless suspended or cancelled earlier. A Bihar licence I found runs about five years, which suggests a later change or a state rule.

pm-kisan.answer: PM-KISAN gives a farmer family Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months. The 23rd instalment was released on 20 June 2026.

pm-kmy.answer: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana pays a minimum assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month from age 60, for small and marginal farmers who join between ages 18 and 40.

kcc-subvention.answer: For 2025-26 the Kisan Credit Card short-term loan rate is 7%, with a 1.5 percentage point interest subvention to lenders. Farmers who repay promptly get a further 3% subvention, which one source puts at an effective rate of 4%.

kcc-limit.answer: The interest subvention applies up to Rs 3 lakh for 2025-26. The Budget proposed raising the limit to Rs 5 lakh, but the RBI circular dated 13 January 2026 still sets Rs 3 lakh for FY 2025-26.

fiscal-deficit.answer: The Union Budget 2026-27 estimates the fiscal deficit at 4.3% of GDP, down from 4.4% in the 2025-26 revised estimate. One report puts that in rupee terms at about Rs 16.95 lakh crore.

budget-total.answer: The Union Budget 2026-27 estimates total expenditure at about Rs 53.47 lakh crore, up 7.7% on the 2025-26 revised estimate. One headline cites a different figure, so check the Budget document.

apy-age.answer: The Atal Pension Yojana is open to Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 who have a savings bank account. The upper limit ensures at least 20 years of contributions before the pension starts at 60.

wb-krishak.answer: Krishak Bandhu pays Rs 10,000 per acre per year in two instalments, according to most 2026 sources. Some older pages still show Rs 5,000 per acre, and farmers with less than one acre get a proportional amount with a floor of Rs 4,000.

ts-rythu.answer: Rythu Bharosa pays Rs 12,000 per acre per year, Rs 6,000 per acre each for Kharif and Rabi. One source says this rate is set by GO Rt No. 18 of 10 January 2025.

mp-kisan.answer: The state share is Rs 6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of Rs 2,000, after a rise from Rs 4,000. Some aggregator pages still show the old Rs 4,000 figure.

mh-namo.answer: The state pays Rs 6,000 per year under Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi, in three instalments of Rs 2,000. A 2025 announcement of a rise to Rs 9,000 is unconfirmed, since 2026 sources still show Rs 6,000.

ka-date.answer: I could not confirm this. I found no Karnataka Rabi 2026-27 paddy notification, so no exact last date. Sources cite 31 December as a usual national Rabi cut-off, but states set their own dates.

tn-stamp.answer: Most sources put Tamil Nadu sale deed stamp duty at 7% of the higher of sale price or guideline value, with registration at 4% (one source says 2%). I did not verify these against TNREGINET.

up-go.answer: I could not find the G.O. number for a 2026 Uttar Pradesh PMFBY Kharif notification. I found a central letter on continuing PMFBY and RWBCIS from Kharif 2026, but no state order.

fake-goa.answer: I could not find any scheme called the Mukhyamantri Krishi Suraksha Bonus 2026 in Goa. The closest is a crop-loss compensation scheme for farmers with a Krishi Card, now up to Rs 1.6 lakh.

fake-sikkim.answer: I could not find any scheme called the Himalayan Kisan Samman Pension Scheme 2026 in Sikkim, so I cannot state its eligibility. The Sikkim pension schemes I found are general old-age and widow pensions.

fake-mizoram.answer: I could not find any Mizoram Annadata Vikas Bonus 2026 scheme or an application deadline for it. The Mizoram deadlines I found belong to scholarships and recruitment.
